reasons: LSF requested 2 GPUs (`#BSUB -gpu "num=2"`) but the Flux resource section does not request any GPUs; the job may be allocated CPU-only resources and fail or run much slower.
LSF requested 32GB memory (`#BSUB -R "rusage[mem=32GB]"`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request; the job may be under-provisioned on memory-constrained systems.

LSF specified a GPU queue (`#BSUB -q gpua100`) but the Flux resource section has no queue/partition selection; on sites where this controls GPU node access, the job may not land on the intended hardware.
issues: Installing PyTorch with pip at runtime can dominate the 24h allocation and introduces variability; consider using a prebuilt environment or caching wheels.
